name: codex-thread-orchestration
description: Orchestrate user-visible Codex tasks with native thread tools, durable state, controller decisions, and optional Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) workers.
keywords: スレッドオーケストレーション

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate visible Codex tasks with durable control state
interface.longDescription: Create, observe, continue, fork, hand off, organize, and review user-visible Codex tasks through the native Codex task-tool family. Keep project resolution, thread addresses, operation intents, results, controller decisions, and optional Coding Agent Orchestrator worker boundaries in an atomic local ledger.
defaultPrompt: Create a dry-run thread-orchestration plan for this project.
Use 上位管制 to coordinate visible Codex tasks and retain their task IDs.
Run one explicitly selected Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow inside each isolated visible worker task.
